# Tales of Biryani

> Chicken dum biryani layered with aged 1121 basmati and Kashmiri saffron, sealed with dough and slow-cooked for 45 minutes in a clay handi.

## Pages

- [Home](/tales-of-biryani/): Chicken dum biryani layered with aged 1121 basmati and Kashmiri saffron, sealed with dough and slow-cooked for 45 minutes in a clay handi.
- [Menu](/tales-of-biryani/menu/): Chicken, mutton, veg and egg dum biryani, with mirchi ka salan and double ka meetha. The Tales of Biryani menu.
- [How we make it](/tales-of-biryani/how-we-make-it/): Overnight marinade, par-cooked 1121 basmati, a dough-sealed handi and 45 minutes on dum: the four steps behind our biryani.
- [Bulk orders](/tales-of-biryani/bulk-orders/): Dum biryani in bulk for parties, office lunches and family events. Send the date, headcount and dishes to request a quote.
- [Reserve a table](/tales-of-biryani/reserve/): Request a table at Tales of Biryani: choose a date, time and number of guests.
